notes:
Original and replication main effects matched independently; pooled analyses and story-specific tests excluded. Original effect r retained as printed, without conversion or correction. Replication effect symbol η² is rendered g² in the author-uploaded PDF text parse. Replication reports study N but does not explicitly identify a post-exclusion analytic N; analytic n is therefore null and n confidence is false. Printed replication denominator df is N−1; retained verbatim without inferring a different sample. Quotes normalize inline formatting only.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Exact p=.002 belongs to the same Serbian distance main effect as F(1, 104) = 9.90 and the effect candidate, excluding pooled or individual-story tests.
